planted_defects.description: Investigation stops at 'operator did not follow SOP' without exploring WHY the operator adjusted the dial. The conflicting statements (operator vs. supervisor) hint at a systemic issue (hopper drift, jamming) that was never investigated. Root cause is labeled 'Human Error' when the true cause is a latent system defect (dial drift, ambiguous SOP, superseded training).

Has the dial been calibrated recently? Were other operators trained on the same SOP revision, and do they also adjust the dial?' These questions would surface the systemic cause.
